exactCanonicalSettings.sourceClause: PHQ-9 score at least 10 is depressed

inputBoundary: One caller-supplied finite numeric PHQ-9 score for one participant, constrained to the source-disclosed closed score range 0 through 27; PHQ-9 item collection and score construction occur before this classifier.
outputBoundary: Classify a score below 10 as non_depressed and a score equal to or above 10 as depressed, using one complementary partition for both canonical settings.
limitations: The source states a PHQ-9 score range of 0 through 27 but does not disclose item-level scoring code, so this binding does not infer questionnaire responses or score construction.
The binding does not require integer-valued scores because integer representation is not stated in the audited source clause.
A missing, nonfinite, or out-of-range PHQ-9 score fails closed before threshold classification.
The reported counts of 18 depressed and 26 non-depressed students are cohort results, not required outputs for an arbitrary fixture.
Participant identity joins, UsageStats collection, launcher exclusion, app categorization, aggregation, and statistical tests are outside this clinical-label boundary.
